title: reconciliation.json
description: What the deck's own numbers say about each other. Produced by reconcile.py from the ledger, the second read, and the model's proposed relations. `relations` holds ONLY what a founder sees — select() decides that, and suppressed relations are reported as counts so nothing downstream can reach past it.

status.description: checked = relations were computed. no_figures = the deck states too few numbers to relate; refused when the deck's own text is full of numerals. gate_failed = the second read could not corroborate enough of the ledger's quotes to trust it. Absence of this artifact means the step did not run, which is a pipeline error and is deliberately distinguishable from all three.

figures_verified.description: Figures whose verbatim quote was found in the second read.

second_read_coverage.description: Which figure-bearing slides the second read actually covered, as DECLARED by the reader — this compares slide-number lists and never inspects the transcript. A figure whose slide is in slides_missing is one nobody looked at: our coverage gap, not the deck's problem. It does NOT follow that such a figure failed the gate — verification matches each quote against the whole transcript without consulting the figure's slide, so a quote from an uncovered slide can still be found in another slide's text.

quote_quality.description: How many of the ledger's quotes carry no word of three or more letters. Such a quote identifies nothing: the gate matches TEXT, so a quote of '$80B' is re-found on any slide that prints $80B and confirms only that the deck contains that figure somewhere. ledger.py warns on each at extraction time; this count is the surface a reader downstream can actually see, because ledger.json is not loaded by compose.

attribution.description: Not a gate — a field. quote_carries_label means the label's words appear in the quote; layout_attributed means they do not, and the figure's meaning rests on where it sat on the slide. The weaker of the two bounds a relation's confidence.

suppressed.description: Counts by reason for every computed relation the founder does NOT see. Contents are deliberately absent.

interpretation.description: The demote-only pass over surviving contradictions. `not_needed` = nothing to interpret. `not_run` = contradictions survived and no pass was supplied, so the founder sees the un-reviewed set. `applied` = the pass ran, and every withdrawal is recorded with its class and reason, because a suppression with no stated ground cannot be audited later.

rendered.description: The founder-facing line, with both sides printed in the same number space.

verdict.description: contradiction and derived are the only two that reach a founder. convention_differs, confirmation and restatement are suppressed by select() and appear only in the counts above.
